# Recursive AI Framework — V15 External Research Boundary

Upstream: https://github.com/recursionlab/recursive-ai-framework

V15 treats the upstream project as an external research object.

## Rules

1. Pin the exact upstream commit before reproducing a mechanism.
2. Record the upstream claim separately from GödelOS interpretation.
3. Map concepts explicitly; do not equate similarly named constructs without evidence.
4. Reproduce behaviour in an isolated adapter/harness before integration.
5. Evaluate reproduced mechanisms on GödelOS held-out tasks.
6. Preserve negative results.

## V15 questions

- Does operator ordering materially change recursive identity behaviour?
- Are non-commutative recursive operators measurable in our three-arm harness?
- Does an external mechanism improve interruption recovery or contradiction handling?
- Does any apparent effect survive content-matched persistence controls?
- Can the mechanism transfer across sealed tasks without prompt-specific tuning?
